app_tagline: See the moment, as it is.
home_desc: A short reflective flow — just enough to see more clearly.
home_no_login: No login. Just a quiet place to gather and respond.
domain_desc: Pick the space that holds your attention.
domain_other_placeholder: Describe the domain in your own words.
question_desc: Write a single question you can carry gently.
question_placeholder: What would make this choice feel aligned three weeks from now?
cast_desc: Choose a quick cast or slow down into a ritual.
cast_quick_text: Tap to cast all six lines at once. The hexagram will appear instantly.
cast_hint: Tap each line from the bottom. Each tap reveals the next line.
result_desc: Primary, movement, and relating — drawn from the meaning store.
cast_missing_body: This moment does not have cast data yet.
movement_none: No changing lines appeared in this cast.
movement_wait: Movement details appear after a cast.
movement_fallback_1: Movement is present, but may be hard to name clearly.
movement_fallback_2: More than one interpretation may fit this moment.
mirror_placeholder_1: The question describes a present tension.
mirror_placeholder_2: A central theme appears in the way it is phrased.
mirror_placeholder_3: The situation reads as active and still forming.
mirror_placeholder_cost_1: Letting go changes the current balance.
mirror_placeholder_cost_2: Holding on keeps a known rhythm.
mirror_placeholder_unknown_1: Some parts of the picture remain open.
cold_placeholder: You are holding two truths at once.
opening_placeholder: What part of this feels most alive right now?
